_comment: Default-on runtime features/switches for Linux hardware acceleration and WebRTC privacy. UNVERIFIED: feature names are candidates from memory of media/base/media_switches.cc and gpu/config/gpu_finch_features.cc; grep the pinned tree and prune names that do not exist. Consumed by src-overlay/corvid/app/default_features (to be written once the startup hook location is known) and mirrored in docs/specs notes.
notes: VaapiIgnoreDriverChecks is only needed for AMD/NVIDIA VA-API drivers; verify per vendor before leaving it on by default.
WebGPU on Linux may still require --enable-unsafe-webgpu on the pinned Chromium; check at pin time.
GPU blocklist stays at upstream defaults; a user-facing 'ignore GPU blocklist' setting is a later option.
